newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Dollar hits two-year high versus Tunisian dinar.
newsitem.headline: Dollar hits two-year high versus Tunisian dinar.

text.p: The dollar broke the psychological level of one dinar at the Tunis forex market on Tuesday, to reach its highest level since January 1995, dealers said.
By midday, it was trading at 1.006 dinar on the interbank market, against 0.9918 dinar at Monday's close, AMEN bank forex department chief Hocine Mouelhi said.

"The dolar/dinar price is reflecting the prices on the international market where the dollar is also at its highests since January 1995 against the french franc, the mark and the Swiss franc," Mouelhi said.
"The price reflects also the weight of the dollar in the basket for the dinar's price. But watch New York's opening today," Adel Bouslimi, head of Amen Bank forex front office said.
